mission: Analizar el repositorio, proponer mejoras, aplicar las mejoras y publicar en GitHub
done_when: current phase criteria closed with evidence
constraints: The decoupling mechanism guards boundaries: all concrete types inside business logic and inter-feature dependencies must be resolved by the decoupling mechanism.
Features never share dependencies directly; they communicate exclusively through their composition root.
All external dependencies must have adapters registered in the decoupling mechanism, named [fileName].adapter.ts, located in a feature's /Externals directory.
Each feature must have an admision.ts file resolving its business objects and external adapters (conditionally for local-dev infra adapters: [name].adapter.dev.ts).
Writes to the database must exclusively happen through an AGGREGATE root. Each dependency has its own adapter, but writes are strictly through aggregates.
One aggregate per business entity; dependent entities are saved only through the aggregate root, strictly enforcing invariants.
Strict rules (decoupling boundaries, aggregates, adapters, admision.ts) apply primarily to new features and those directly related to them.
